newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DE BOER TWINS TO STAY WITH AJAX UNTIL 2004.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DE BOER TWINS TO STAY WITH AJAX UNTIL 2004.

text.p: Twins Ronald and Frank de Boer will stay with Dutch champions Ajax until 2004, the Dutch news agency ANP said.
Midfielder Ronald and defender Frank, 26, extended their contracts on Thursday, a day after Ajax reached the semifinals of the European Cup by beating Atletico Madrid.
The deal put an end to speculation that the brothers would move abroad. Some reports had linked them to London club Arsenal.
